UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Minimal non-PII user account anchor used for relational ownership checks.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account anchor was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account anchor was last updated.

UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Isolated PII profile document and learner score metrics stored under users/{userId}/private/profile.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

email.description: Verified email address from Google authentication.

photoUrl.description: Profile avatar URL or empty string.

totalScore.description: Cumulative AI assessment score points earned across videos and final exams (0 to 1000000).

testsCompleted.description: Total number of AI assessments completed (0 to 10000).

videosCompleted.description: Total number of learning videos completed with an AI test (0 to 10000).

certificatesEarned.description: Total number of skill mastery certificates earned (0 to 1000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

LearningPath.title: LearningPath
LearningPath.description: Personalized adaptive learning roadmap, diagnostic summary, skill tree, 7-day study plan, bookmarks, video test scores, final exam, and mastery certificate.

id.description: Learning path identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

dailyMinutes.description: Daily focus budget in minutes (30, 45, 60, or 120).

strengths.description: Bounded list of up to 12 detected strengths.

knowledgeGaps.description: Bounded list of up to 12 detected focus areas.

selectedNodeId.description: Currently selected skill node ID or empty string.

recommendedNextId.description: Recommended next skill node ID or empty string.

nodes.description: Bounded list of up to 25 skill tree nodes.

edges.description: Bounded list of up to 60 prerequisite edges.

studyPlan.description: Bounded list of up to 14 daily study plan entries.

bookmarkedVideoIds.description: Bounded list of up to 50 bookmarked YouTube video IDs.

latestSynthesis.description: Optional map storing the most recent AI study notes and Mermaid flowchart.

videoTestResults.description: Bounded list of up to 30 post-video AI test score records.

finalExam.description: Optional map storing the latest comprehensive final AI exam result.

certificate.description: Optional immutable map storing the earned certificate of mastery.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the learning path was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the learning path was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Minimal user account anchor documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{profileDocId}.description: Private PII user profile and cumulative score metrics stored at profileDocId = 'profile'.

/users/{userId}/learningPaths/{pathId}.description: User-owned adaptive learning roadmaps, progress, study plans, bookmarks, notes, test scores, and certificates.
